mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.5pp in a month (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 days as production constraints erode corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5% annually (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average compresses the equity risk premium and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, which triggers a monetary tightening expectation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises by >0.3pp in a month (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE above 8.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0 and PAYEMS change < 0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative mean returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative mean returns).
